changes: Build-root absolute path prefix becomes relative to the fresh working directory.
Unused source include_path for N56r19 becomes rtl;. in this netlist-only recipe. Netlist has no include or readmem dependencies; literal INIT values stay unchanged.

limits: Frozen diagnostic/release-input rebuild, not the current development source build.
A newly synthesized/routed image is a new candidate: identical bitstream bytes, timing closure and hardware behavior are not guaranteed.
Vendor encrypted IP is preserved as supplied. A compatible licensed Gowin installation is required; vendor IP is not regenerated.
Preparation only verifies bytes and relocatable paths; no Gowin process or board is invoked.
Neo REJECT R1 is an experimental diagnostic image: COPY rejection remains unresolved and timing is not closed.
This is a reroute of the exact mapped application netlist, not a synthesis of Neo RTL.
